attacks.name: Mental Vampire
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|*Drain Life|: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt damage, remove 1 |!damage| from this character.

attacks.name: Devastate Intellect
steps: If this attack would deal |!damage|, it does not and the defender loses that much |!power| instead.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!wild| |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.
|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!hit| |!failure| |!failure| |*Devour Mind|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is Healthy, it becomes Dazed. If the defender is Injured, it becomes KO'd.

superPowers.name: Submit!
superPowers.body: This character may spend up to 5 |!power| to use this superpower. Choose a Civilian token within |!range| X of this character, where X is the amount of |!power| spent to use this superpower. This character may interact with the chosen token without paying the |!power| Cost.

superPowers.name: Supreme Control
superPowers.body: When an allied character within |!range| 4 of this character would be pushed, this character may use this superpower. The allied character is not Pushed.

superPowers.name: Ethereal
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer 2 or more |!damage| from a |!physical| attack or collision, it suffers 1 |!damage| instead. Additionally, if this character suffers damage from a |!physical| attack or collision, it drops all objective tokens it is holding.

superPowers.name: Omnipathy
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character rolls 1 or more |!critical| in any roll, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
